items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I left the Cruzes to go into Los Angeles with the, with the band called Max Melody Makers... The leader of Max Melody . . . was -- his name was Max Rangel.

ctx.x: Who was the leader of that band, of Max Melody Makers? Do you recall?
The leader of Max Melody . . . was -- his name was Max Rangel.
